user.title: WRM Water Consumption
user.description: Sign in to your water utility's WRM portal. Your password is only used to sign in and is not stored — the integration keeps the login session (cookies) instead.

reauth_confirm.title: WRM session expired
reauth_confirm.description: The saved session for {email} has expired. Enter your password to sign in again.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure WRM Water Consumption
reconfigure.description: Update the portal URL or polling interval for {email}. Enter your password to re-authenticate and refresh the session.

error.invalid_base_url: Use an HTTPS URL on a WRM Systems subdomain (*.wrm-systems.fi).
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the portal.

import_history.name: Import reading history
import_history.description: Backfill historical water meter readings into long-term statistics.

start.name: Start date
start.description: First date to import (yyyy-MM-dd). Defaults to all history.

end.name: End date
end.description: Last date to import (yyyy-MM-dd). Defaults to all history.
